Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
We had a situation arise, and I want to know the official way to handle
it.

Acting vampire played Darkness Within before range. Blocking vampire
has 1 blood. Acting vampire declares a hand strike. Which of the
following happens :

1) Blocking vampire burns one blood from Darkness Within, and takes one
damage. Blocking vampire has no blood, and goes to torpor.

2) Blocking vampire takes one damage. Then loses no blood to Darkness
Within since vampire has no blood. Vampire does not go to torpor.

3) Some other possibility that I hadn't thought of.

Since the acting minion played Darkness Within, and both effects were
simultaneous, the acting minion chose 1 above. Were we correct?
